svg.title: Labeled 20 micrometre photodiode array
svg.text: 1. Reset transistor — Charges the sensing node
2. Source-follower transistor — Buffers the sensing voltage
3. Row-select transistor — Connects the pixel to its column
5. Horizontal metal buses — Control, power and local signals
6. Column output wire — Shared vertical readout
7. Dummy fill — Density pattern around devices
Inside one pixel — the same three transistors and photodiode repeat nine times
Original VNC screenshot with source-coordinate callouts. Dark diode clearance keeps fill away; it is not extra junction area.
